The players' VAZ-2108 (F10), from the \"VAZ-2108 Rally\" model by matthew0451 on Sketchfab: sketchfab.com/matthew0451, CC BY-NC 4.0 license. Lightened, livery removed (one colour and number per player).
Every player can have their own rally VAZ-2108, free: F10 > VAZ-2108 tab. Sixteen colours, one per player; the colour also gives the number painted on the doors.
Pick a free colour then Take: the car appears next to you, for everyone.
Bring here (or V): brings it back next to you, if nobody is driving it.
Give back: it disappears and its colour is free again. When you leave the game, the host keeps your colour and where your VAZ was: you find it again when you come back.
Can be turned off like the other add-ons: Settings > Co-op > MWCoop additions (the host's choice applies to everyone). 3D model by matthew0451, CC BY-NC 4.0 licence (Guide > Credits).
